set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 0 item 1.

Commit b756b4bb (MASC role-coverage audit) exists only inside the unregistered clone .worktrees/feature-values-dev; the main repo's object database does not contain it.

Scope:
Fetch into a main-repo ref and verify; inventory the clone for other unreachable work. No deletion here.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The main repo has a ref (e.g. refs/heads/rescue/audit-masc-role-corpus) pointing at b756b4bb.
2. `git for-each-ref --contains b756b4bb` in the main repo lists that ref.
3. `git rev-parse b756b4bb^{tree}` prints the same tree id in the main repo and in the clone.
4. Every branch tip and stash in the clone is checked for reachability from a main-repo ref; any unreachable commit is rescued the same way or listed for the owner.
5. A progress note records the ref name, the tree id and the reachability check.

Gate: fresh-context cold review of the committed text; the commit body states what changed and
what it does not establish.

Size: S.
set.title: Phase 0: rescue the only copy of audit/masc-role-corpus (b756b4bb) into the main repo
